name: OGALLERY Light
author: ocodewp

sections.description:
OGALLERY Light is a modern visual gallery builder for WordPress, designed to make polished image galleries fast to create and effortless to manage.

Build Grid and Masonry galleries directly from the WordPress Media Library, refine their presentation visually, add polished hover interactions and open images in a configurable Classic Lightbox — all from one focused gallery workspace.

OGALLERY is builder-agnostic. Publish each gallery with a shortcode and place it wherever WordPress accepts shortcodes.

Designed separately for every device

Desktop, Tablet and Mobile can be configured independently.

Instead of relying only on automatic scaling, OGALLERY lets you tailor the gallery presentation for each device view separately, including columns, spacing and other presentation settings.

Visual Gallery Studio

Create and refine galleries in a focused visual workspace with a live preview of your changes.

Grid Galleries

Build clean, structured image galleries with configurable columns, spacing, image proportions, fit and focal-point controls.

Masonry Galleries

Create natural image compositions that preserve the proportions of individual images while maintaining precise spacing and presentation controls.

Hover Effects

Add polished hover interactions without writing custom CSS or JavaScript. OGALLERY Light includes ready-to-use hover modes and configurable hover icons.

Classic Lightbox

Present gallery images in the built-in Classic Lightbox with controls for navigation direction, title and description visibility, background color and opacity, image sizing, corners, transitions, swipe/button navigation and looping.

WordPress Media Library

Select and manage gallery images through the native WordPress Media Library. No separate media account or external image service is required.

Shortcode Publishing

Every gallery has its own shortcode, so you can place OGALLERY galleries in pages, posts, custom post types, page builders and other shortcode-compatible areas.

No account. No activation key. No time limit.

All functionality included in OGALLERY Light works without an external account, activation key, subscription or trial period.

OGALLERY Light Features

  • Visual Gallery Studio with live preview
  • Grid gallery layout
  • Masonry gallery layout
  • Independent Desktop controls
  • Independent Tablet controls
  • Independent Mobile controls
  • Device-specific columns and spacing
  • Image proportion controls
  • Image fit and focal-point controls
  • Corner radius controls
  • Ready-to-use hover effects
  • Configurable hover icons
  • Classic Lightbox
  • Lightbox navigation, appearance and transition controls
  • WordPress Media Library integration
  • Shortcode publishing
  • Builder-independent output
  • No external account required
  • No activation key required
  • No time limit

Discover OGALLERY Full

OGALLERY Full is the complete edition for photographers, designers, agencies, stores and visual-first WordPress websites that need more advanced layouts, presentation modes and professional gallery workflows.

In addition to its expanded feature set, OGALLERY Full provides significantly more design and behavior controls throughout the Studio, giving you deeper control over gallery appearance, interactions, navigation, lightboxes and presentation.

Advanced Gallery Layouts

Create more distinctive compositions with:

  • Justified
  • Bento
  • Polaroid
  • Masonry Straight Bottom

Sliders & Carousels

Create dynamic gallery presentations with:

  • Slider
  • Carousel
  • Podium Slider

WooCommerce Product Galleries

Create dedicated product presentations with:

  • Product Bento
  • Product Slider
  • Product Podium

Hover Studio

Create reusable custom hover effects in a dedicated layer-based visual editor.

Advanced Lightboxes

Go beyond Classic Lightbox with:

  • Cinematic Lightbox
  • Dream Lightbox
  • Thumbnail navigation
  • Social sharing

Image Filters

Let visitors explore gallery content using interactive filtering based on OGALLERY tags.

Advanced Image Sources

Build galleries from additional WordPress content sources, including Media Folders and ACF fields.

Albums & Media Folders

Organize larger image collections and reuse them across gallery workflows.

Client Proofing

Provide clients with a dedicated workflow for reviewing and selecting images.

Standalone Galleries & Access Control

Publish standalone gallery experiences and protect selected galleries with password access.

Image Protection

Add watermarking and right-click protection when additional image safeguards are needed.

Reusable Gallery Styles

Save, apply, export and import gallery styles to maintain consistent presentation across galleries and projects.

More Design & Behavior Controls

OGALLERY Full includes a substantially expanded set of controls throughout the Studio for more detailed customization of gallery structure, appearance, interactions, navigation, lightboxes and presentation behavior.

sections.installation:
1. Install OGALLERY Light from the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add Plugin.
  2. Activate OGALLERY Light.
  3. Open OGALLERY from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create a new gallery and select images from the WordPress Media Library.
  5. Choose Grid or Masonry.
  6. Configure Desktop, Tablet and Mobile independently as needed.
  7. Adjust spacing, image presentation, hover effects and Classic Lightbox settings.
  8. Save the gallery and copy its shortcode.
  9. Place the shortcode wherever you want the gallery to appear.
sections.faq:
Does OGALLERY Light require an account?

No. OGALLERY Light works without creating an external account.

Does OGALLERY Light require a license key?

No. The functionality included in OGALLERY Light works without a license key or activation.

Is OGALLERY Light a trial?

No. OGALLERY Light does not expire and has no time limit.

Which gallery layouts are included in OGALLERY Light?

OGALLERY Light includes Grid and Masonry gallery layouts.

Additional gallery layouts are available in the separately distributed OGALLERY Full edition.

Can Desktop, Tablet and Mobile be configured separately?

Yes. OGALLERY provides independent controls for Desktop, Tablet and Mobile, allowing columns, spacing and presentation settings to be tailored for each device view.

Does OGALLERY Light include a lightbox?

Yes. OGALLERY Light includes the configurable Classic Lightbox.

OGALLERY Full adds Cinematic Lightbox and Dream Lightbox with additional presentation and navigation options.

Does OGALLERY work with page builders?

Yes. OGALLERY publishes galleries using WordPress shortcodes and is not tied to a specific page builder.

Where do gallery images come from?

OGALLERY Light integrates with the native WordPress Media Library.

Does OGALLERY Light include hover effects?

Yes. OGALLERY Light includes ready-to-use hover effects. OGALLERY Full additionally includes Hover Studio for building reusable custom hover effects visually.

What is the difference between OGALLERY Light and OGALLERY Full?

OGALLERY Light focuses on the core gallery workflow with Grid, Masonry, independent Desktop/Tablet/Mobile controls, hover effects and Classic Lightbox.

OGALLERY Full is a separately distributed premium edition with advanced layouts, sliders and carousels, WooCommerce product galleries, Hover Studio, advanced lightboxes, filtering, additional image sources, Albums, Media Folders, Client Proofing, standalone galleries, access control, image protection, reusable gallery styles and a substantially expanded set of design and behavior controls.

Get OGALLERY Full →
